# Health Issue Data Model (Firestore)

This document outlines the Firestore data model for managing health issues within the Health Healing application.

## Main Collection: `health_issues`

Each document in this collection represents a single health issue for a user.

**Document ID:** Auto-generated by Firestore.

**Fields:**

*   `userId` (String): The UID of the user who owns this health issue. (For querying and security rules)
*   `issueName` (String): The name or title of the health issue. (Mandatory)
*   `startDate` (Timestamp): The date of onset or discovery of the issue. (Mandatory)
*   `severityLevel` (String): The severity of the issue (e.g., "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe"). (Mandatory)
*   `status` (String): The current status of the issue (e.g., "Active", "Resolved", "In Remission"). Defaults to "Active".
*   `symptoms` (String): A textual description of the symptoms. (Optional)
*   `medications` (String): A textual description of medications being taken. (Optional)
*   `doctorClinic` (String): Name or details of the doctor or clinic. (Optional)
*   `isRecurring` (Boolean): Indicates if the issue is recurring. Defaults to `false`. (Optional)
*   `nextFollowUpDate` (Timestamp, nullable): The date for the next follow-up reminder. (Optional)
*   `fileUploads` (List<Map<String, String>>): A list of maps, where each map contains `fileName` and `downloadURL` for an uploaded file associated directly with the issue. (Optional)
    *   Example: `[{ "fileName": "blood_report.pdf", "downloadURL": "https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/..." }]`
*   `createdAt` (Timestamp): Server timestamp indicating when the issue was created.
*   `updatedAt` (Timestamp): Server timestamp indicating when the issue was last updated.

## Sub-collection: `issue_updates`

Nested within each `health_issue` document, this sub-collection stores a chronological history of updates or logs related to that specific health issue.

**Collection Path:** `health_issues/{issueId}/issue_updates`

**Document ID:** Auto-generated by Firestore.

**Fields:**

*   `updateText` (String): The textual content of the update or log entry.
*   `updateDate` (Timestamp): Server timestamp indicating when the update was added.
*   `files` (List<Map<String, String>>): A list of maps, where each map contains `fileName` and `downloadURL` for files uploaded as part of this specific update. (Optional)
    *   Example: `[{ "fileName": "xray_scan.jpg", "downloadURL": "https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/..." }]`

**Data Flow Considerations:**

*   When a new health issue is created, a document is added to the `health_issues` collection.
*   When a user adds an "update" to an existing health issue, a new document is added to the `issue_updates` sub-collection of the parent health issue document.
*   Files uploaded will be stored in Firebase Storage, and their download URLs will be stored in the `fileUploads` field (for issue-specific files) or the `files` field (for update-specific files).
*   The `status` field in the main `health_issues` document will be updated as needed (e.g., when an issue is marked as "Resolved").
*   The `updatedAt` field in the main `health_issues` document should be updated whenever the issue itself or any of its updates are modified.

**Example Structure (Conceptual):**

```json
{
  "health_issues": {
    "issueId123": {
      "userId": "userUidAbc",
      "issueName": "Persistent Migraine",
      "startDate": "2024-04-01T00:00:00Z",
      "severityLevel": "Moderate",
      "status": "Active",
      "symptoms": "Throbbing pain on one side, sensitivity to light.",
      "medications": "Sumatriptan 50mg as needed.",
      "doctorClinic": "Dr. Emily White, Neurology Dept.",
      "isRecurring": true,
      "nextFollowUpDate": "2025-06-15T00:00:00Z",
      "fileUploads": [
        { "fileName": "initial_consult_notes.pdf", "downloadURL": "..." }
      ],
      "createdAt": "2024-05-01T10:00:00Z",
      "updatedAt": "2024-05-06T09:30:00Z",
      "issue_updates": {
        "updateIdXyz": {
          "updateText": "Visited Dr. White. Prescribed new medication.",
          "updateDate": "2024-05-06T09:30:00Z",
          "files": []
        },
        "updateIdPqr": {
          "updateText": "Symptoms slightly improved after starting new medication.",
          "updateDate": "2024-05-10T14:00:00Z",
          "files": []
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
